description: This file implements ASN.1 string handling functions, including table-based string setting, retrieval, and management for cryptographic identifiers, with internal data structures and functions for handling ASN.1 string constraints and mappings.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_set_default_mask
methods.description: Sets the default mask for ASN1 strings (empty implementation).

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_get_default_mask
methods.description: Returns the default mask for ASN1 strings, defaulting to B_ASN1_UTF8STRING.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_set_default_mask_asc
methods.description: Sets the default mask from an ASCII string (stub implementation returning 1).

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_set_by_NID
methods.description: Creates or updates an ASN1_STRING based on a NID, applying constraints from a string table if available.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_TABLE_add
methods.description: Adds a new ASN1 string constraint entry to the internal table.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_TABLE_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up ASN1 string table resources (empty implementation).

methods.name: asn1_get_string_table_for_testing
methods.description: Provides access to the internal standard ASN1 string table for testing purposes.
